parts.title: Who Stole The Light?! | TheOneApp Promo 3 #Shorts
parts.description:
A dark shape swallows the great lamp of TheOneApp Station. A riddle? A curse? Pip, Momo and Basil follow the clues to a shadow, and bring the light back. A short adventure from TheOneApp, the science study app for Primary 3 to 6 in Singapore.

Parents: see TheOneApp and try it free for 7 days at https://theoneapp.sg

The only app you need to learn Science: TheOneApp.
